intro.text: A Highlord in the Kholin army in Alethkar, a senior commander who discusses strategy with King Elhokar.

items.text: Shaday joined the strike team that tried to retake the Oathgate in Kholinar. He hoped the Voidbringers and the corrupted Palace Guard would turn on each other, but Elhokar dismissed the idea. Only a few people reached the Oathgate before the army was overrun, and Shaday's fate is unknown.
